paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist a Thessalonika a om saptuamte kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

paite: Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Unaute aw, na ginna uh nakpitak a khanglian in, na vek ua na ki-ittuah chiatna uh akhan semsem ziak in noumau tungthu ah Pathian kiang a kipahthu gengen ding him ka hi uh; huai ka hihtuak him uh ahi.
heading: Kipahthu Genna
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

paite: Huaiziak in mi'n ahon sawina tengteng uleh gim na thuaknate ua na kuhkaldan uleh na ginna ziak un Pathian saptuam pawlte lak ah koute mahmah in ka hon suang uhi.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

paite: Huai lah Pathian' vaihawmna adiktat chih chiamtehna ahi a, tu a Pathian kumpigam mi a seh tak na hi uh chih kilatna semsem ahi; huaiziak a leng thuak na hi ngal ua.
heading: Pathian In Thuk Nawn Ding
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

paite: Pathian in nou hon hihgimte gimthuakna a thuk diktathuai in asepta hi.
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

paite: Toupa Jesu van a kipan a-angel hatte toh meikuang a hong kilak chiang a, nou hihgim a omte koute toh khawlna ahon pe ding hi.
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

paite: Pathian theiloumi leh i Toupa Jesu tanchinhoih taksangloute tung ah phu ala ding hi.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

paite: Amau tangtawn manthatna a gawtna leh Toupa omna leh athilhihtheihna thupina a kipan posiahna athuak ding ua,
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

paite: amah ahong pai chiang in misiangthoute hih thupi in a-om ding ua, gingtute tengteng lak ah lamdangsak in a-om ding uhi, ka hon thu theihsak uh na gintak ziak un nou leng amaute lak ah na tel sam ding uhi.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

paite: Huchi a hih thupi leh lamdangsak ahihtheihna ding a i Pathian in nou ahon sapna a sap tuak him ahon saktheihna ding in leh lungtaina chiteng leh ginna nasep chiteng a thilhihtheihna a ahon lohchinsak theihna ding in noute a ding in ka hon thumsak gige uhi;
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

paite: huchi a i Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna bang zel a i Toupa Jesu min noumau a hih thupi a om a, noumau leng amah a hih thupi a na omtheihna ding un.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
